meta.authored: By hand, pass 0040. Nothing scanned this repository to produce it; it is a claim about how the parts fit, and every node names the artifact that backs it.
meta.edgeDirection: from depends on to, so to is drawn BELOW from. The flow therefore reads UPWARD: stage-plan depends on stage-new. PSGraphRender's foundation view flips the arrowhead onto the dependent end, so the drawn arrow points from new up to plan.
meta.layers: scope carries the stated layer, bottom to top: method, instruments, plugin, module, user. The rows flow.html draws are derived from the edges and need not match the stated layers row for row.

attributes.who: the director writes it; every pass obeys it
attributes.what: the method, with every rule marked PORTABLE, TUNE or DOMAIN
attributes.why: so a reader can tell which rules survive a change of domain and which are this project's furniture

attributes.who: the executor, once per pass
attributes.what: the pass format: sync, preconditions, red-first, per-task evidence, deviations, verify script, local handoff
attributes.why: a session restart clears the conversation and not the repository

attributes.who: the operator decides; the agent cites
attributes.what: fifteen append-only records, each settling one thing that kept being re-argued
attributes.why: a convention stated once and referred to afterwards, rather than re-derived per pass

attributes.who: run against any module repository, this project's or yours
attributes.what: the shape oracle - 41 cases across Universal, Repository, HouseStyle and RequiresBuild
attributes.why: shape is the part an agent gets wrong repeatably, so it is the part worth grading mechanically

attributes.who: run against the Azure DevOps build target
attributes.what: a hand-written 49-node, 51-edge expected graph, a brief, a fixture and a seed
attributes.why: shape says the module was built correctly; only this says it was built right

attributes.who: the Terraform line, runs tf-001 and tf-002
attributes.what: three frozen repositories and a case list, frozen by decision 0011 and re-frozen by 0012
attributes.why: the first evidence that anything here crosses a language boundary

attributes.who: the blind run tf-003
attributes.what: three more repositories, written mute - no case annotations anywhere in them
attributes.why: the tf skills were written against fixture 1, so only a fixture they never saw can test generality

attributes.who: every scored run, on both lines
attributes.what: Compare-Graph.ps1 for Azure DevOps and evals/tf/Compare-TfGraph.ps1 for Terraform
attributes.why: a score is a comparison, and the comparison has to be an executable somebody else can re-run

attributes.who: installed by a stranger at a tag, never from main
attributes.what: nineteen skills and two commands, distilled from what the instruments measured
attributes.why: the findings had to live somewhere an agent would read them without being told to

attributes.who: you type it
attributes.what: builds or extends a module to the house conventions
attributes.why: where a skill and the suite disagree, the suite is the oracle and the disagreement is a finding

attributes.who: you type it
attributes.what: the module's own build and the conformance suite, reported as two numbers
attributes.why: averaging a build score with a conformance score hides which one moved

attributes.who: you, with an empty directory
attributes.what: nothing has been decided yet, and that is the point
attributes.why: the stage that exists so the next one is not skipped
attributes.skills: none - this is where you paste prompts/first-module.md

attributes.who: the plan skill asks; you answer
attributes.what: six questions, then docs/PLAN.md in your repository with a definition of done
attributes.why: a definition of done written after the work is written to fit the work
attributes.skills: powershell-module-plan. ORDER IS REAL: intake comes first, or everything after it is a coin-flip nobody recorded.

attributes.who: the executor, against the conventions
attributes.what: command surface, tree, manifest, build script, help, completers, analysis
attributes.why: the stage the conformance suite was written to grade
attributes.skills: architect, scaffold, build, docs, ux, analyzer. ORDER IS REAL for architect and scaffold before build - you cannot emit a psm1 for a surface nobody has designed. ORDER IS NOT REAL between docs and ux, which run alongside build, nor for analyzer, which is a task inside the build rather than a stage after it.

attributes.who: the ordered runner, five layers, stopping at the first failure
attributes.what: manifest parses, files parse, module imports, unit, integration
attributes.why: one unparseable file otherwise reports as thirty-seven failing tests
attributes.skills: powershell-module-test. ORDER IS REAL: this follows build, because layer 3 imports what build emitted.

attributes.who: run once, immediately before a version
attributes.what: naming, surface-versus-docs parity both ways, dead files, docs/PLAN.md currency
attributes.why: most of what it finds is drift between two things that were both correct when they were written
attributes.skills: powershell-module-tidy. ORDER IS REAL: last, and never a substitute for the suite.

attributes.who: the agent prepares; the operator publishes
attributes.what: semver against the module surface, changelog, worklog, staging and output layout
attributes.why: Publish-Module is the operator's alone, from their own shell, and always will be
attributes.skills: powershell-module-release then powershell-module-deploy. ORDER IS NOT REAL between the two; both precede a publish nobody here performs.

attributes.who: the start of any new module or feature
attributes.what: a fixed six-question intake, a shorter delta set, and a plan file written into the target
attributes.why: every question exists because leaving it unasked forced a coin-flip later

attributes.who: before a single file exists
attributes.what: verb-noun, one command one question, when to split, Public versus Private
attributes.why: the command prefix is not the module name, and an assertion scoped to the name catches nothing

attributes.who: once per module
attributes.what: the exact tree the suite grades, plus the committed dev loader
attributes.why: src/ is otherwise un-importable, and a loader written twice means two meanings of $script:ModuleRoot

attributes.who: the build script and its tasks
attributes.what: InvokeBuild tasks, ParseError in the analyzer severities, the coverage gate, exit-code discipline
attributes.why: carries F-1, and carries the coverage gate that graded nothing across three independent runs

attributes.who: public and private functions alike
attributes.what: comment-based help, the house .EXAMPLE standard, about_ topics, the culture directory
attributes.why: the helper nobody wrote help for is the one nobody recognises later

attributes.who: any parameter whose values are enumerable
attributes.what: when a parameter earns a completer, and which of the three mechanisms it earns
attributes.why: added at v1.2.0; no scored run has used a completer, and the record says so

attributes.who: a task inside the build, not a stage after it
attributes.what: AST-driven analysis that never runs the code it reads
attributes.why: reading a module by importing it executes whatever that module executes on import

attributes.who: the suite and the ordered runner
attributes.what: the Pester 6 rules that bite, the five-layer runner, and zero cases is not a pass
attributes.why: a layer that ran nothing graded nothing, and reports INAPPLICABLE rather than PASSED

attributes.who: immediately before a version
attributes.what: the pre-release sweep, and a refusal to bless a release with an open Bucket-A item
attributes.why: added at v1.2.0; one of its own rules was inert because it was scoped by the module name

attributes.who: staging, never publishing
attributes.what: staging and output layout, and why Publish-Module is the operator's alone
attributes.why: nothing in this repository may reach a gallery by being followed

attributes.who: at a version boundary
attributes.what: semver against a module surface, changelog and worklog conventions
attributes.why: a major is what breaks an existing user, not what felt large to write

attributes.who: only a module talking to Azure DevOps
attributes.what: the Azure DevOps REST API, read-only
attributes.why: the PAT comes from the environment and nowhere else - never a parameter, never a file, never a URL

attributes.who: pipeline YAML, one repository or many
attributes.what: extracting and resolving references, with parsing separated from resolution
attributes.why: a parser that also resolves cannot be tested without the thing it resolves against

attributes.who: turning references into a graph
attributes.what: identity by what a node is, never by where a traversal reached it
attributes.why: carries F-2 - identity by discovery path duplicates every shared template

attributes.who: reading .tf files
attributes.what: blocks rather than a whole-file regex, required_providers in both spellings, the raw expression text kept
attributes.why: withheld from v1.0.x so that a fixture it had never seen could test it

attributes.who: a module source string
attributes.what: the leading-dot guard, the double slash past the scheme, the unresolvable target as a flagged node
attributes.why: a producer that silently drops what it could not resolve reports a graph that looks complete

attributes.who: ids, containment and edges
attributes.what: ids that carry their repository, containment from the directory tree rather than the calls, one fact as one edge
attributes.why: containment stated twice is two statements of one thing, and they can disagree

attributes.who: any producer emitting for a consumer it does not own
attributes.what: absent versus false, the consumer's battery, never renaming what the contract names
attributes.why: NOTHING IN THIS REPOSITORY GRADES IT. The battery that does lives in PSGraphRenderToHtml, which is why this node has no edge down into the instruments. It also fits neither naming prefix, which the README records as a gap rather than a slip.

attributes.who: the executor, while several skills are in play
attributes.what: response formatting during multi-skill work
attributes.why: NOTHING IN THIS REPOSITORY GRADES IT either. It is about the shape of a reply, and no oracle here reads replies.

attributes.who: you, on your own domain
attributes.what: what the flow produces: a conforming PowerShell module in your own repository
attributes.why: it earns its own numbers - nothing measured here transfers to it by being adjacent

attributes.who: this project's own build target
attributes.what: a read-only Azure DevOps pipeline dependency grapher, built and scored five times
attributes.why: the one module whose numbers here are real, and the reason the plugin says what it says

attributes.who: a stranger with a subscription and an empty directory
attributes.what: the person the whole stack is pointed at. You enter at the `new` stage, with prompts/first-module.md.
